# Compiler benchmark corpus

`compiler-demo-v1.luxo` is an immutable copy of
`editors/vscode/examples/demo.luxo` at core commit
`dbd269d586a71739b69dd6acb1a26b85f50483d0`.

- Size: 34,735 bytes.
- SHA-256: `0f5e8717ae3031e8d1ae08eb473d929c9f9b4a00164f6a6d329726f30f9b8c2e`.
- Purpose: keep the existing `*DemoFile` benchmark inputs comparable when editor
  examples or documentation change. Do not edit this file or update its checksum
  merely to accept an input change; introduce a separately named V2 benchmark.
- Scope: lexical analysis, parsing, formatting, and semantic analysis including
  diagnostics. The original baseline already reports semantic errors for this
  corpus. It is not a valid current application or an end-to-end compiler test.
- Current editor examples remain in their original directory and are validated
  separately. This fixture must never be used as an application template.

The shared test helper embeds the source so benchmark execution cannot silently
skip it because of a working-directory or packaging mistake. The integrity test
checks the original bytes, not a reformatted or normalized replacement.
